title: Every composite gets one producer
hook: Every composite gets one producer. Follow the computed steps.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Integer remainders, gcd, primes, modular exponentiation.
doesNotKnow: Use least-prime-factor order to mark each composite once and stop after the current least prime.

misconception: A sieve must revisit a composite for every prime factor.
objective: Use least-prime-factor order to mark each composite once and stop after the current least prime.

claims.text: Each composite is generated through its least prime factor. Stopping the inner prime loop at the current least factor prevents alternative producers from marking the same composite again.
